content: Ka tho hane lawkcengnae dawk Cathut pholennae la

content.text: Oe BAWIPA koe la katha sak awh.
Talai taminaw pueng, BAWIPA koe la sak awh.
BAWIPA koe la sak awh nateh,
a min teh pholen awh.
Rungngangnae kamthang kahawi teh hnintangkuem pathang awh.
Miphun pueng koe a bawilennae teh pâpho awh haw.
Tami pueng koe kângairu lah a onae hah pâpho awh.
BAWIPA teh a len, puenghoi pholen hanelah ao,
Cathut pueng hlak taki hanelah ao,
Miphunlouknaw e cathut pueng teh ayawmyin doeh.
BAWIPA ni teh kalvan hah a sak.
A hmalah barinae hoi taluenae teh ao.
A hmuen kathoung koe thaonae hoi meihawinae teh ao.
Oe, tami pueng hoi imthung pueng,
BAWIPA teh bawilennae hoi thaonae hah poe awh.
BAWIPA e min teh, bawilennae poe awh.
Pasoung hno sin laihoi a thongma koe tho awh.
Oe, thoungnae kamthoup laihoi BAWIPA bawk awh.
Talai taminaw pueng a hmalah pâyaw awh.
Miphun pueng koe BAWIPA ni a uk tet awh.
Talaivan hai kacaklah kangdue sak teh, kâhuen mahoeh.
Ama ni kalan lah lawk a ceng han.
Kalvan teh lunghawi naseh,
talai hai konawm naseh.
Talîpui hoi a thung e kaawm e pueng
ni hai cairing naseh.
Law hoi a thung e kaawm e pueng lunghawi naseh.
kahrawng e kaawm e pueng nihai
BAWIPA koe konawm laihoi la sak naseh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ama teh a tho.
Talai taminaw lawkceng hanelah a tho.
Talaivan hah lannae hoi lawkceng vaiteh,
a lawkkatang hoi tami lawk a ceng han.
